reviewWords.mnemonic: 正式文件陳述條款動詞；名詞 state of the art (最先進的技術)。

example.en: We intended to dispatch the shipment today; however, severe weather forced a temporary delay.

reviewWords.mnemonic: 描述規模常用：large quantity (大量)、at large (普遍地/整體而言)。

example.zh: 各大線上影音串流平台正展開激烈的市場商戰，爭奪體育賽事的獨家數位轉播權。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商業競爭比喻：legal battle (訴訟大戰)、market battle (市佔率爭奪戰)。

example.en: We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and thank you again for your patience.
example.zh: 我們對造成的不便深表歉意，並再次感謝您的耐心配合。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 客服道歉信結尾高頻句：Thank you once again (再次感謝您)。

example.en: What kind of warranty coverage is provided with the commercial laser printer?
example.zh: 這款商用雷射印表機隨附何種保固保障？

reviewWords.mnemonic: 詢問規格常用：what kind of (哪一種)；形容詞 kind assistance (親切協助)。

example.en: Please keep your original purchase receipts for at least thirty days to facilitate warranty claims.
example.zh: 請妥善保留原始購買收據至少三十天，以便辦理保固理賠。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商務溝通片語：keep in mind (牢記在心)、keep updated (隨時保持最新資訊)。

example.en: We were very pleased to hear that your company was awarded the regional trade contract.
example.zh: 我們非常高興得知貴公司榮獲該區域貿易合約。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商務社交致賀常客：hear from someone (收到某人來信/消息)。

example.en: The corporate headquarters upgraded its internal payroll system to automate tax calculations.
example.zh: 企業總部升級了內部薪資核算系統，以實現稅額自動計算。

reviewWords.mnemonic: IT與辦公科技核心詞：computer system (電腦系統)、operating system (作業系統)。

example.en: Safety inspectors conduct thorough maintenance checks on factory elevators every six months.
example.zh: 安全檢查員每六個月對工廠電梯進行一次全面的維護檢查。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 頻率周期考點：every year (每年)、every six months (每六個月)。

example.en: The seminar presenter will answer audience questions during the final twenty minutes of the session.
example.zh: 研討會主講人將在會議最後二十分鐘回答現場觀眾的提問。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 會議問答標準詞：question and answer (Q&A 問答環節)。

example.en: Employees may purchase discounted meals in the company cafeteria during lunch hours.
example.zh: 員工可以在午休時間於公司員工餐廳購買優惠餐點。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益介系詞大考點：during 後接表示期間的名詞 (如 during the meeting)。

example.en: The hiring committee will select the most qualified candidate for the manager post.
example.zh: 聘雇委員會將挑選出最適任該經理職位的人選。

reviewWords.mnemonic: se- (分開) + lect (挑選) ＝ 從眾多之中挑出。

example.en: The resort hotel is surrounded by tranquil tropical gardens and sandy beaches.
example.zh: 該度假飯店被寧靜的熱帶花園與沙灘所圍繞。

reviewWords.mnemonic: sur- (在上方、超過) + round (圓) ＝ 繞成一圈圍住。

example.en: Management launched an assessment to determine the full extent of the factory damage.
example.zh: 管理階層展開評估，以確定工廠受損的完整程度與範圍。

reviewWords.mnemonic: ex- (向外) + tend (伸展) ＝ 伸展到的距離 ＝ 程度、範圍。

example.en: The convention center offers scenic river views from all banquet hall rooms.
example.zh: 會議中心的所有宴會廳皆享有優美的河景風光。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 常見飯店地段描述：river view (河景客房)、river cruise (遊船)。

example.en: Please ensure the corporate registration form is fully completed before submission.
example.zh: 提交之前，請務必確認企業註冊表格已完全填寫無誤。

reviewWords.mnemonic: full (滿的) + -ly (副詞尾) ＝ 完全地、充分地。

example.en: In sharp contrast to last quarter, corporate retail revenues increased by twelve percent.
example.zh: 與上一季形成鮮明對比的是，企業零售營收增長了百分之十二。

reviewWords.mnemonic: contra- (反對、相反) + st (站立) ＝ 相反兩者擺在一起 ＝ 對比。

example.en: The telecommunications giant plans to roll out its fiber network nationwide this spring.
example.zh: 這家電信巨頭計劃於今年春季在全國範圍內推出鋪設其光纖網路。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益極高頻片語：roll out (正式推出新產品或服務)。

example.en: Budget planners must balance innovative design ambitions with fiscal reality.
example.zh: 預算規劃人員必須在創新的設計願景與財務現實之間取得平衡。

reviewWords.mnemonic: real (真實的) + -ity (名詞尾) ＝ 現實情況。

example.en: High-resolution product photographs must be uploaded to the promotional web catalog.
example.zh: 高解析度的產品照片必須上傳至線上促銷型錄。

reviewWords.mnemonic: photo- (光) + -graph (寫、畫) ＝ 用光線記錄的圖像 ＝ 照片。

example.en: Our advertising firm hired a talented digital artist to design the corporate logo.
example.zh: 我們的廣告公司聘請了一位極具才華的數位美工設計師來設計企業標誌。

reviewWords.mnemonic: art (藝術、技巧) + -ist (人) ＝ 藝術家或平面視覺設計師。

example.en: Due to a schedule conflict, the executive director postponed the quarterly review meeting.
example.zh: 由於行程衝突，執行董事推遲了季度審查會議。

reviewWords.mnemonic: con- (共同) + flict (打擊) ＝ 互撞衝突 ＝ schedule conflict (行程衝突)。

example.en: The chief executive commended the entire marketing department for outstanding quarterly results.
example.zh: 執行長讚揚了整個行銷部門卓越的季度業績表現。

reviewWords.mnemonic: en- (在內) + tire (完整無損) ＝ 完整的、整個的。

example.en: Our firm seeks to expand its commercial market presence across Southeast Asia.
example.zh: 我們公司致力於擴大在東南亞的商業市場版圖與影響力。

reviewWords.mnemonic: present (在場的) + -ence (名詞尾) ＝ 出席或市場佈局 (market presence)。

example.en: Large crowds gathered at the flagship electronics store for the weekend launch.
example.zh: 大批人潮聚集在旗艦電子商城門口，參加週末的上市活動。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 形容詞 crowded (擁擠的)，多益交通與商展常考情境。

example.en: The new express cafe is conveniently located on the corner of Maple and Main Street.
example.zh: 這間新開的快捷咖啡廳座落於楓樹街與主街的轉角處，交通非常便利。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 店面位置或辦公空間：on the corner (在轉角)、corner office (邊間高階主管辦公室)。

example.en: Rental car agreements require drivers to return the vehicle with a full tank of gas.
example.zh: 租車合約要求駕駛人在還車時必須將油箱加滿汽油。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 租車與能源常見搭配：gas station (加油站)、natural gas (天然氣)。

example.en: Assembly line factory technicians work in alternating eight-hour shifts.
example.zh: 組裝產線的工廠技術人員採取八小時輪班制工作。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 人資班表必備：day shift (日班)、night shift (夜班)、shift work (輪班工作)。

example.en: The corporate annual financial report showed a twenty percent rise in net profit.
example.zh: 該企業年度財務報告顯示淨利成長了百分之二十。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 財務必考對比：gross (毛利/總計) vs net (淨利/實收)。

example.en: Office supplies and packaging materials are filed under separate expenditure categories.
example.zh: 辦公用品與包裝耗材歸屬於不同的支出分類項目下。

reviewWords.mnemonic: cata- (向下、完全) + agoreuein (公開宣布、聚集) ＝ 分門別類。

example.en: The executive secretary scheduled all overseas video conferences for senior management.
example.zh: 主管秘書為高階管理層安排了所有海外視訊會議。

reviewWords.mnemonic: secret (秘密) + -ary (人) ＝ 保守機密並協助主管處理政務的人 ＝ 秘書。

example.en: Upgrading firewall protocols provides an essential defense against cyber intrusions.
example.zh: 升級防火牆通訊協定為防範網路入侵提供了關鍵的防禦屏障。

reviewWords.mnemonic: de- (遠離) + fens (打擊、抵擋) ＝ 擋開外部打擊 ＝ 防禦。

example.en: We appreciate your quick response to our urgent corporate supplier inquiry.
example.zh: 感謝您針對我們先前緊急的企業供應商詢價所給予的迅速回覆。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 客戶溝通核心用詞：quick response / quick reply (迅速回覆)。

example.en: The hotel restaurant hired an executive head cook to revamp its dinner menu.
example.zh: 飯店餐廳聘請了一位行政主廚來全面重新設計晚餐菜單。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 餐飲宴會核心：cook meals (烹調餐點)；head cook / chef (主廚)。

example.en: Word of mouth helped spread news of our annual discount sale across town.
example.zh: 口碑傳播有助於將我們年度特賣活動的消息在全城散播開來。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 資訊傳播 (spread the word)；金融名詞指利差 (interest rate spread)。

example.en: The power utility operates nuclear energy generators under stringent safety guidelines.
example.zh: 這間電力公用事業公司在極為嚴格的安全規範下營運核能發電機組。

reviewWords.mnemonic: nucle- (核心、原子核) + -ar ＝ 核能發電 (nuclear power)。

example.en: Automated warehouse facilities achieve substantial economies of scale in distribution.
example.zh: 自動化倉儲設施在配送物流中實現了顯著的規模經濟效益。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 商業擴張極核心：economies of scale (規模經濟)、on a large scale (大規模)。

example.en: Customer satisfaction remains the key driver of corporate revenue growth this year.
example.zh: 客戶滿意度依然是今年推動企業營收成長的關鍵驅動因素。

reviewWords.mnemonic: drive (駕駛/驅動) + -er ＝ 司機或推動成長的要素 (growth driver)。

example.en: The charity gala dinner was held in the hotel's grand ballroom on the second floor.
example.zh: 慈善晚宴於飯店二樓的大宴會廳隆重舉行。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 飯店場地核心詞彙：ballroom (宴會廳、大廳)。

meaning: 大相徑庭(a far cry from)

example.en: The modern digital logistics terminal is a far cry from the cramped old warehouse.
example.zh: 這座現代化的數位物流航廈與過去那間狹小老舊的倉庫相比真可謂天差地別。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益聽力閱讀常考成語：a far cry from (與...大相逕庭、相去甚遠)。

example.en: The introduction of automated ticketing kiosks significantly shortened airport lines.
example.zh: 自動取票機的引進大幅縮短了機場旅客的排隊等候時間。

reviewWords.mnemonic: intro- (向內) + duct (引導) + -ion ＝ 引導進入 ＝ 引進、介紹。

example.en: A bachelor's degree in engineering is a mandatory requirement for this technical post.
example.zh: 具備工程學士學位是應徵該技術職位的必要必備條件。

reviewWords.mnemonic: require (要求) + -ment (名詞尾) ＝ 招聘徵才條件 (job requirement)。

example.en: The regional distribution hub is located twenty kilometers north of downtown Seattle.
example.zh: 區域配送物流轉運中心位於西雅圖市中心以北二十公里處。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 交通地理指引：North Wing (北側大樓/航廈)、north of (在...以北)。

example.en: The guest requested another room on an upper floor away from street traffic noise.
example.zh: 該房客要求換到遠離街頭交通噪音的高樓層另一間客房。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 飯店服務與更換選項必備字：another room (另一間房)、one another (彼此)。

example.en: Through consistent product innovation, our company has become a leader in green energy technology.
example.zh: 透過持續的產品創新，我們公司已成為綠色能源科技領域的領導者。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 企業發展歷程與地位轉變常態動詞：become a leader (成為領先者)。

example.en: The commercial bank offers very competitive interest rates on corporate expansion loans.
example.zh: 該商業銀行針對企業擴張貸款提供極具競爭力的利率優惠。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益財務重要考點！名詞常考「利息」：interest rate (利率)；show interest in (對...展現興趣)。

example.en: Our international distribution network delivers consumer goods to over fifty countries globally.
example.zh: 我們的國際配送網路將消費性商品送達全球五十多個國家。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 跨國貿易與物流高頻考名詞：across the country (全國各地)、foreign country (外國)。

example.en: The facility manager decided to replace the old computer servers with energy-efficient models.
example.zh: 廠房主管決定將老舊的電腦伺服器更換為節能型機種。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 設備淘汰與更新對話常見詞：replace old equipment (更換老舊設備)。

example.en: Each team member is expected to submit a weekly progress update by Friday afternoon.
example.zh: 每位團隊成員均須在週五下午前提交每週進度更新報告。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 多益文法必考：each 後接單數名詞與單數動詞。

example.en: The corporate foundation provides annual scholarships to local vocational school students.
example.zh: 該企業基金會每年向在地職業學校的學生提供獎學金。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 企業社會責任 (CSR) 與實習招募常考單字。

example.en: Passengers arriving late for boarding will not be permitted to enter the aircraft.
example.zh: 登機遲到的旅客將不被允許進入機艙。

reviewWords.mnemonic: 交通延誤與繳費罰款必考：late fee (滯納金/逾期罰款)。
